purpose: Inspect an analyst-recommendation portfolio's metadata only; no return values read or calculated

release_binding.limitation: Matching public files and publisher version statement are not a per-signal build manifest or independently reproduced build; observed tag commit is later than initial release.

limitations: The publisher identifies a code version and relevant files match a pre-release repository snapshot, but exact per-signal build inputs remain unverified.
Finite portfolio average signal values do not prove all individual signals are valid or point-in-time.
The provider documentation flags lack of data. Underlying I/B/E/S inputs, identities, revisions, costs, rights, benchmark and tradable holdings are unverified.

The inspected preparation SQL has no ORDER BY and does not sort by announcement date before writing the input; the predictor groups and takes the last row. Input order is unverified. It labels records with the start of the announcement month and the predictor does not read activation dates; downstream lag and release binding are unverified.
Counts are metadata, not evidence of an edge. No portfolio returns were read or calculated.
